description: "Visit to Iceland and the Scandinavian North" by Ida Pfeiffer is a travel narrative written in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: The book chronicles Pfeiffer’s journey as she embarks on an adventure to Iceland, driven by her deep curiosity and passion for exploring unique natural phenomena and cultures.

authorInfo.bio: Ida Pfeiffer (1797–1858) wrote Visit to Iceland and the Scandinavian North. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
